integrity: The triple-parametrization, three-factor congruence, nonsingular quadratic-character intersection counts and exact p-adic lift count give a complete all-prime proof; independent direct pair-fiber computation corroborates finite instances.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes at least five, prime-square rings and unit quadratic perturbations.
The proved invariant is additive energy and the exact constant-input fourth moment, not a sharp unrestricted operator norm.
Unindexed prior equivalent calculations remain a bibliographic risk.
Finite computation corroborates the proof; it does not establish the all-prime statement.
title: Exact fourth moments of unit-perturbed quartic graphs over prime-square rings
